d.ko: Erenshor is a single player RPG with the soul of a classic MMO - built for players who miss the journey.  Partner up with Erenshor's signature SimPlayers and explore an open world where every reward comes with a story. Discover thousands of items, quests, raids, and secrets - all at your own pace.
